notes.scope: The current named normal, unique, rod skill, rod ability, blessing, and curse enchantments.
notes.imagePolicy: Text-first accepted because enchantments are abstract modifiers and the source does not provide distinct row icons.

item.name: Agile
item.effect: Reduces cooldowns by 6%, 9%, or 12% by level.
item.cardSummary: Agile is a normal weapon enchantment for weapons. Reduces cooldowns by 6%, 9%, or 12% by level.

item.name: Beast
item.effect: Raises damage against Beast users by 3% per level, up to 15%.
item.cardSummary: Beast is a normal weapon enchantment for weapons. Raises damage against Beast users by 3% per level, up to 15%.

item.name: Deadly
item.effect: Raises damage against players by 2% per level, up to 10%.
item.cardSummary: Deadly is a normal weapon enchantment for weapons. Raises damage against players by 2% per level, up to 10%.

item.name: Efficient
item.effect: Raises XP from NPCs by 15% per level, up to 60%.
item.cardSummary: Efficient is a normal weapon enchantment for weapons. Raises XP from NPCs by 15% per level, up to 60%.

item.name: Elemental
item.effect: Raises damage against Elemental users by 3% per level, up to 15%.
item.cardSummary: Elemental is a normal weapon enchantment for weapons. Raises damage against Elemental users by 3% per level, up to 15%.

item.name: Fortune

item.cardSummary: Fortune is a normal weapon enchantment for weapons. Raises Money drops from NPCs by 15% per level, up to 60%.

item.name: Lucky
item.effect: Raises NPC drop rates by 5% per level, up to 20%.
item.cardSummary: Lucky is a normal weapon enchantment for weapons. Raises NPC drop rates by 5% per level, up to 20%.

item.name: Natural
item.effect: Raises damage against Natural users by 3% per level, up to 15%.
item.cardSummary: Natural is a normal weapon enchantment for weapons. Raises damage against Natural users by 3% per level, up to 15%.

item.name: Piercing
item.effect: Ignores 6% of defensive buffs per level, up to 24%.
item.cardSummary: Piercing is a normal weapon enchantment for weapons. Ignores 6% of defensive buffs per level, up to 24%.

item.name: Sharp
item.effect: Raises damage against NPCs by 3% per level, up to 18%.

item.name: Siphon
item.effect: Restores 4%, 6%, or 10% of damage dealt as energy.
item.cardSummary: Siphon is a normal weapon enchantment for weapons. Restores 4%, 6%, or 10% of damage dealt as energy.

item.name: Vampiric
item.effect: Heals 4%, 6%, or 10% of damage dealt.
item.cardSummary: Vampiric is a normal weapon enchantment for weapons. Heals 4%, 6%, or 10% of damage dealt.

item.name: Baitless Catch
item.effect: Adds a 2% per level chance not to consume bait.
item.cardSummary: Baitless Catch is a normal rod enchantment for fishing rods. Adds a 2% per level chance not to consume bait.

item.name: Experience Sharing
item.effect: Shares 5% fishing XP per level with nearby players and also grants it to the user.
item.cardSummary: Experience Sharing is a normal rod enchantment for fishing rods. Shares 5% fishing XP per level with nearby players and also grants it to the user.

item.name: Fish Scanner
item.effect: Raises the final luck factor by 2% per level.
item.cardSummary: Fish Scanner is a normal rod enchantment for fishing rods. Raises the final luck factor by 2% per level.

item.name: Resilient Fishing Rod
item.effect: Raises rod resilience by 2% per level.
item.cardSummary: Resilient Fishing Rod is a normal rod enchantment for fishing rods. Raises rod resilience by 2% per level.

item.name: Tasty Bait
item.effect: Raises the chance for fish to bite faster by 2% per level.
item.cardSummary: Tasty Bait is a normal rod enchantment for fishing rods. Raises the chance for fish to bite faster by 2% per level.

item.name: Masterpiece
item.effect: Skills cost no energy, damage rises by 5%, and cooldowns fall by 8%.
item.cardSummary: Masterpiece is a unique enchantment for weapons. Skills cost no energy, damage rises by 5%, and cooldowns fall by 8%.

item.name: Rage
item.effect: Raises movement speed on hit, with duration scaling from base damage.
item.cardSummary: Rage is a unique enchantment for weapons. Raises movement speed on hit, with duration scaling from base damage.

item.name: Sharpshooter

item.cardSummary: Sharpshooter is a unique enchantment for weapons. Raises damage by 10% but raises cooldowns by 20%.

item.name: Strong Grip
item.effect: Scales damage from 40% Melee and 60% Sword or Gun stats.
item.cardSummary: Strong Grip is a unique enchantment for weapons. Scales damage from 40% Melee and 60% Sword or Gun stats.

item.name: Unbreakable

item.cardSummary: Unbreakable is a unique enchantment for weapons. Prevents held skills from being interrupted for 2 seconds.

item.name: Unreal

item.cardSummary: Unreal is a unique enchantment for weapons. Cuts cooldowns by 20% but lowers damage by 15%.

item.name: Reel Boost

item.cardSummary: Reel Boost is a rod skill enchantment for fishing rods. Temporarily raises rod strength for 10 seconds.

item.name: Calming Technique

item.cardSummary: Calming Technique is a rod skill enchantment for fishing rods. Slows fish movement by 50% for 10 seconds.

item.name: Conserve Bait

item.cardSummary: Conserve Bait is a rod skill enchantment for fishing rods. Reduces bait consumption chance by 25% for 120 seconds.

item.name: Fishing Rod Protector

item.cardSummary: Fishing Rod Protector is a rod ability enchantment for fishing rods. Prevents one line snap per catch, then adds 30% progress and calms the fish.

item.name: Burning

item.cardSummary: Burning is a blessing enchantment for weapons. Applies Burn for 4 seconds on hit, scaling from final damage.

item.name: Frozen

item.cardSummary: Frozen is a blessing enchantment for weapons. Applies Slowness for 5 seconds on hit, scaling from base damage.

item.cardSummary: Rot is a blessing enchantment for weapons. Applies Rot to fruit users for 4 seconds and strongly reduces healing.

item.name: Blessing of an Angler's Treasure

item.name: Blessing of Bait Efficiency
item.effect: Adds a 20% chance not to consume materials while crafting bait.
item.cardSummary: Blessing of Bait Efficiency is a blessing enchantment for fishing rods. Adds a 20% chance not to consume materials while crafting bait.

item.name: Curse of the Reaper
item.effect: Halves health regeneration and adds life drain against players and NPCs.
item.cardSummary: Curse of the Reaper is a curse enchantment for weapons. Halves health regeneration and adds life drain against players and NPCs.

item.name: Curse of the Thief

item.cardSummary: Curse of the Thief is a curse enchantment for weapons. Raises enemy aggression, XP and Money gains, but also raises damage taken by 25%.

item.name: Curse of the Leviathan

item.cardSummary: Curse of the Leviathan is a curse enchantment for fishing rods. Catching a specific species may disturb the Leviathan.

item.name: Curse of the Whale
item.effect: Raises final fish weight by 15% but may consume two bait.
item.cardSummary: Curse of the Whale is a curse enchantment for fishing rods. Raises final fish weight by 15% but may consume two bait.

item.cardSummary: Curse of the Terrorshark is a curse enchantment for fishing rods. Starts a catch with 20% extra progress but makes fish panic faster.
